extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: 3.0 m tileable brick wall, 240 mm thick, 2.09 m high incl. 320 mm concrete coping; standard bricks 240 x 115 x 71 mm, 10 mm joints, 12 courses per metre
extras.notes: Tileable along X: module ends at x = -1.5 / +1.5 m with half a head joint on each side, English-style block bond (stretcher and header courses alternating, period 0.25 m) and coping stones every 0.5 m, so walls of any length continue without a visible joint. Every brick is real geometry with its own shade (mixed firing), raked joints 6 mm deep, efflorescence and dirt near the ground. Pitched concrete coping with drip grooves.

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
